criteria.text: Run respects #746 cold-start window + per-run caps (proposals/run, LLM calls/run, external results/run) — the seeded prompt instructs the agent to do this.
criteria.reason: The cold-start guard and per-run caps are enforced inside the LLM-driven optimizer run itself (prompt-level instruction + the agent's own tool-call budget), not observable via a unit test against the seed function. Verified by manual review of the seeded prompt text at PR review time and by the existing #746 cold-start unit coverage (issue_746_latency.test.ts) on the shared engine-ready gate the prompt references.
